INSERT INTO totd_queue
                    (translatable_id, sort_key, scheduled_date, assigned_by, assigned_at, is_auto)
                SELECT $1::uuid,
                       hashtextextended($1::uuid::text || c.seed, 0),
                       $2,
                       $3,
                       now(),
                       false
                FROM totd_queue_config c
